permissions.name: camera
permissions.purpose: Scan equipment QR and barcode labels
permissions.retention: No video or camera frames are stored
permissions.revocation: Camera stream stops when scanner modal closes

permissions.name: geolocation
permissions.purpose: Capture distributor coordinates or verify field check-in
permissions.retention: Only approved business coordinates or check-in distance are stored
permissions.fallback: IP-based location requires a separate explicit action

permissions.name: files
permissions.purpose: Import approved spreadsheets, backups, and work photos
permissions.activation: User file picker or drag and drop
permissions.controls: Extension, MIME, size, structure, and resource limits

permissions.name: clipboard-write
permissions.purpose: Admin-only copy of an integrity-protected backup
permissions.controls: Secure context, size limit, no clipboard read

android: Declare only CAMERA and location permissions that remain in use
Show purpose before the runtime permission prompt
ios: Request When In Use location only
Stop capture sessions when leaving the scanner
shared: No permission request at application startup
Re-request only after a user action
